description: First floor extension providing one flat (1 x 2 bed)
decision_conditions:
<p>The proposal, by reason or of insufficient Gross
Internal floor Area (GIA) together with inadequate living space and floor to
ceiling heights would provide an overall cramped and substandard quality of
living accommodation, to the detriment of the residential amenities of the
existing and future occupiers of the unit, contrary to policies DM1 and DM 26
of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013)&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify;">and GR1 of the draft Harrow local plan 2021-2041.</span></p>

<span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">The proposed first floor extension, by reason of its, mass, scale and bulk, adjacent to the footway in a surburban setting would introduce an overbearing and obtrusive form of development which would fail to respect the character, massing, form and composition of the site and&nbsp; surrounding area. The proposal would therefore fail to meet with the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), and&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">would&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">conflict with Policies D3&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">(D</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">(1) and D(11</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">)</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">, of&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">T</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">he London Plan (2021), Policy CS1.B of the Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">adopted&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010) and GR1 of the draft Harrow local plan 2021-2041.</span><table border="1" cellspacing="0" style="border: 1pt solid windowtext; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;" class="Table"><tbody></tbody></table>
